source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with towering layered mountains, diagonal pine-covered ridges, mist-filled valleys, a secluded pavilion compound, water crossing with bridge and figures, varied foreground tree groves, rocky banks, and small travelers on a right-hand path. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_towering_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the large central mountain mass rising in the upper middle: a tall pale peak with rounded summit, layered vertical and diagonal contour strokes, dark hemp-fiber texture dots, and clustered black foliage accents along ridgelines.
must_preserve: pale ink wash gradients on the main face
dense black texture dots along ridges
small dark shrub clusters near the crest

motifs.name: right_diagonal_pine_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the right-middle system of diagonal hillsides with bands of dark pines climbing across the slopes, including the stepped ridgelines and rounded washed rock forms beneath them.
must_preserve: short black texture strokes on hill edges

motifs.name: left_misty_valley_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the left-center mist-filled valley: enclosing cliffs, distant rounded hills, soft blank mist basin, and scattered stippled trees descending into the haze.
must_preserve: soft mist edges and unpainted voids
subtle wash transitions into the valley

motifs.name: pine_hidden_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the secluded building cluster among tall pines in the lower-left middle: tiled roofs, rectilinear walls, narrow vertical trunks, and the small stepped approach path nestled against the hillside.
must_preserve: narrow path strokes leading to the buildings

motifs.name: water_bridge_with_scholars
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left water crossing: calm inlet, uneven banks, plank or arched wooden bridge, and two small scholar figures standing on the bridge.
must_preserve: small dark reflections or supports beneath bridge
soft bank washes around the crossing

motifs.name: central_foreground_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central foreground grove and winding path: varied trees with different leaf textures, tall trunks, dark foliage masses, exposed roots, and low rocks at the base.
must_preserve: contrasting leaf textures including dots and hooked strokes
small foreground rocks and ink accents

motifs.name: right_path_travelers_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right hillside path with two tiny travelers and the surrounding sparse trees: leafless branching trunks, dark leafy trees, rounded path contour, and adjacent slope washes.
must_preserve: dark clustered foliage on nearby trees
light hillside wash and dotted ground texture

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the bottom foreground rocky ledge and low bank, excluding the red seal: a chain of rounded rocks, dark stippled moss, uneven earth contour, and shallow wash at the painting’s front edge.
must_preserve: broken dry-brush texture along the ledge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
